gloss: to be stumped; to be fed up; to be at a loss

definitions.gloss: to be stumped; to be fed up; to be at a loss; to be unable to cope
definitions.explanation: To be so troubled, annoyed, or overwhelmed by a situation that one does not know what to do or say. Literally 'to close one's mouth' — rendered speechless by difficulty or annoyance.

examples.japanese: この{暑|あつ}さには{閉口|へいこう}する。
{彼|かれ}の{長|なが}い{話|はなし}には{閉口|へいこう}した。
examples.english: I was fed up with his long-winded talk.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{続|つづ}く{残業|ざんぎょう}に{閉口|へいこう}して、ついに{転職|てんしょく}を{決意|けつい}した。
examples.english: Fed up with the daily overtime, I finally decided to change jobs.

notes:
USAGE:
The pattern 〜に{閉口|へいこう}する is the most common usage, where に marks the thing causing frustration. Expresses a mixture of annoyance and helplessness — one is not just annoyed but at a loss for how to deal with the situation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜に{閉口|へいこう}する (be stumped/fed up by ~)
- {閉口|へいこう}させられる (be made to feel at a loss)
- すっかり{閉口|へいこう}する (be completely fed up)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- うんざりする: to be fed up/disgusted — more colloquial; stronger emphasis on disgust
- {困|こま}る: to be troubled — broader and more neutral; does not carry the 'speechless' nuance
- {辟易|へきえき}する: to be intimidated/put off — similar formality; emphasizes recoiling from something overwhelming
